theorem lg_target {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ := by
  have h1 : n ≠ 0 := Ne.of_gt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
  have h2 : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℚ :=
    Rat.addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow n h1 hn
  rw [h2]
  apply AddSubmonoid.eq_of_le_superset
  exact Set.subset.antisymm_iff.1 (AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℚ_subset_nonneg_ℤ)
  exact Set.subset.antisymm_iff.2 (AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℤ_subset_nonneg_ℚ)
